title: LumaFusion Pro
description: The ultimate mobile video editor for professionals. Desktop-grade multi-track editing on iPad, iPhone, and Android.
icon: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='150' height='150' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><rect width='100' height='100' rx='22' fill='%232563eb'/><path d='M30 35 L70 35 L70 65 L30 65 Z M38 28 L46 35 M54 28 L62 35' stroke='%23ffffff' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/><polygon points='45,43 60,50 45,57' fill='%23ffffff'/></svg>
summary: LumaFusion Pro bridges the gap between mobile flexibility and professional NLE software. With multi-track magnetic timelines, robust 3D color correction, keyframe animation, and speed ramping, it remains the industry standard for content creators.
pros: Up to 6 video/audio tracks for complex timeline editing
Intuitive magnetic timeline optimized for touch controls
Advanced 3D color grading with custom LUT import
One-time purchase without recurring subscription fees
Seamless direct export to YouTube, Vimeo, and cloud storage
cons: Learning curve for complete video editing novices
Android version features catch up slightly behind iOS updates
Stock footage library requires optional Storyblocks add-on
editorRecommendation: LumaFusion Pro is the premier mobile video editor available today. If you perform serious video production or mobile filmmaking, it is worth every penny.
